packages.headline: FragPunk Reveals Farlands: New Delivery PvPvE Adventure Now Available in Early Access

sources.label: Xbox Wire
sources.evidenceText:
FragPunk has launched its biggest new chapter yet with Farlands, a permanent, multiplayer delivery-driven PvPvE adventure where dozens of players share a persistent world, now available in Global Early Access on PC and console.
FragPunk Reveals Farlands: New Delivery PvPvE Adventure Now Available in Early Access
FragPunk has launched its biggest new chapter yet with Farlands , a permanent, multiplayer delivery-driven PvPvE adventure where dozens of players share a persistent world, now available in Global Early Access on PC and console.
Farlands combines high-stakes cargo deliveries with resource gathering, combat, and long-term progression in a sandbox combat experience. Players take on delivery orders, venture into dangerous territories to collect resources, and transport their cargo safely to its destination. But delivering cargo is more than simply traveling from point A to point B. Cargo weight, changing environmental conditions, and encounters with other players can all influence the outcome of a run.
What makes Farlands particularly unique is that all of this takes place in a persistent world that continues to evolve over time.
A World in Constant Flux: Inside Farlands’ Core Design
Farlands features a persistent server system that allows players to return to the same continuously evolving environment.
Dynamic Weather: Weather conditions such as heat, cold, and rain accelerate the depletion of players’ health and affect cargo transportation. Players need to monitor their condition and consider how different weather conditions affect their ability to carry cargo, carefully planning their loads and delivery objectives while keeping themselves in good condition.
Beyond its evolving environment, Farlands also brings player interactions and long-term progression into its core delivery gameplay loop.

packages.headline: World of Warcraft Forever Is the Biggest WoW Launch in History

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
Even during the beta, World of Warcraft Forever was shaping up to be huge, with an unprecedented amount of testers. But, over the weekend Blizzard announced that World of Warcraft Forever had the biggest launch in WoW history.
World of Warcraft Forever Is the Biggest WoW Launch in History
Even during the beta, World of Warcraft Forever was shaping up to be huge, with an unprecedented amount of testers. Over the weekend, Blizzard announced that World of Warcraft Forever had the biggest launch in WoW history.
The news came over X/Twitter, where the official World of Warcraft account posted that Forever was the biggest launch in WoW history, both in terms of peak concurrent players and the number of returning players. Keep in mind that this history includes Wrath of the Lich King and Warlords of Draenor, both of which had huge launches – though the latter didn't exactly maintain it.
WoW Forever didn't just break records by dragging old players in and convincing them to resub. Holly Longdale, Blizzard's executive producer and vice president for World of Warcraft, posted her own statistic , saying, "Another statistic is filling our hearts – we are seeing the most NEW players for a WoW launch in 15 years!" That means WoW Forever has brought more players in than any WoW expansion since Cataclysm first launched 16 years ago in 2010.
Congratulations everyone, you made HISTORY! WoW: Forever has achieved: 🔹The biggest launch in WoW history by peak concurrent players 🔹The highest number of returning players in WoW history This is all because of you, the players. From all of us, THANK YOU! https://t.co/MQxQXmNDbA
Scrolling through Longdale's replies, it's clear that people are loving WoW Forever. There are a ton of fans talking about how they played all weekend, like Dungeons and Dragons senior game designer Joey Haeck , who posted a picture of himself on a Zeppelin leaving Orgrimmar, saying, "Congratulations to the whole Forever team! I'm having a blast on every packed zeppelin and every open vista."
While we here at IGN don't have a full review yet, our early review is positive, with reviewer Len Hafer talking about her beta experience , saying, "I ended my beta journey at level 13, gazing out across the dusty plains of Westfall, because I didn't want to spoil too much for myself before the big day. But from what I have seen so far? I think they might have done it. They made me believe I can go home again – and that home is somewhere I want to spend more time, with new surprises to discover. Let's see if they can keep it up for 47 more levels. Watch this space for updates in the weeks to come."
While it's obviously been a huge success, Blizzard had been cooking World of Warcraft Forever on the back burner for a while, only pulling the trigger on its full development after it saw how successful Season of Discovery was back in 2023 . Even with the massive load of players logging in at launch, WoW Forever had an extremely smooth launch , thanks to running on a massive amount of hardware . There was even a race to max level, which took three whole days before someone hit the level cap of 60 .

イケメン元カレ100人がどんどん死ぬ、“乙女復讐”ゲーム『元カレ×デスゲーム』発表。生かすも殺すもプレイヤー次第のイカゲーム風デスゲーム
デベロッパーのLIUGUANG STUDIOは、『 元カレ×デスゲーム 』を発表した。対応プラットフォームはPC（Steam）。Steamストアページによると、ゲーム内は日本語表示に対応予定だ。
『元カレ×デスゲーム』は、映像が主体のアドベンチャーゲームだ。主人公は、元カレたちによって幾度となく傷つけられてきた女性「スー・ウェイ」。彼女は浮気や嘘、裏切りなどの罪を犯した“100人の元カレ”を一隻の豪華客船に集め、復讐のデスゲームを開催する。哀れな元カレたちに、裁きの鉄槌を下すのだ。
本作は、実写風の映像を鑑賞しながら選択肢を選び、物語を進めていくインタラクティブムービー形式を採用している。詳細は明らかにされていないが、開発元によるとデスゲームの各ラウンドでは誰を脱落させるかをプレイヤー自身が決定できるとのこと。どの元カレを生かし、どの元カレに罰を下すかを選択できるわけだ。
そんな本作には、趣向を凝らしたさまざまな試練が用意されているという。Steamストアページでは、「真心話か罰ゲームの審判」「ガラスの橋」「深海の嘘発見器」といった試練が確認できる。たとえば「ガラスの橋」は、その名の通りガラス張りの足場を渡る試練とみられ、ドラマ「イカゲーム」や漫画「賭博黙示録カイジ」を彷彿とさせる。また、こうした試練は過激さが次第にエスカレートしていき、極限状態に追い込まれた元カレたちの仮面が一枚ずつ剥がされていくとのことだ。ゲームを通して、人間の醜い本性が暴かれていくのだろう。
そのため、従来の乙女ゲームのような恋愛や育成をメイン要素とするのではなく、復讐によって得られる爽快感を重視した物語に仕上げているとのこと。また、11月3日時点でデモ版の開発は約80％まで完了しており、製品版は2027年初頭にSteam向けに配信する計画だという。果たして何人の元カレが生還できるのか。気になる方はウィッシュリストに登録しておくとよいだろう。
